name: field
title: Field
description: The engine behind the primitives' built-in error handling — the label-line layout (error takes the hint's place in the label row, label turns red, nothing below moves) plus a context that wires id / aria-invalid / aria-describedby. You rarely use it directly: pass label / error to Input, Textarea, SelectTrigger or Search instead. Use <Field> to wrap a custom control. Uses --destructive-text from ds-theme.
